They played their home games at [[Palestra|The Palestra]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] and were led by fourth-year head coach [[Steve Donahue]]. The Quakers finished the season 19–12, 7–7 in Ivy League play to finish in a three-way tie for fourth place. As the No. 4 seed in the [[2019 Ivy League men's basketball tournament|Ivy League tournament]], they lost in the semifinals to [[2018–19 Harvard Crimson men's basketball team|Harvard]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Penn Quakers men's basketball team|Quakers]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 24–9, 12–2 in Ivy League play to win a share of the Ivy League regular season championship with [[2017–18 Harvard Crimson men's basketball team|Harvard]]. In the [[2018 Ivy League men's basketball tournament|Ivy League tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team|Yale]] and Harvard to become Ivy League Tournament champions. They received the Ivy League's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Kansas Jayhawks men's
